entities.summary: Michael Norman Finn was an English musician. He was best known as the percussionist and sideman to Marc Bolan in his band Tyrannosaurus Rex and later the 1970s glam rock group T. Rex. After Bolan's death and T. Rex's demise, he worked as a session musician for The Blow Monkeys and The Soup Dragons.
